name: oklch-skill
description: OKLCH color space for web projects. Convert hex/rgb/hsl to oklch, generate palettes, check contrast, handle gamut boundaries, and theme with Tailwind v4. Triggers on oklch, color conversion, palette generation, contrast ratio, gamut, display p3, design tokens, hue drift, chroma, dark mode colors.
author: jakubkrehel
readme: [![skills.sh](https://skills.sh/b/jakubkrehel/oklch-skill)](https://skills.sh/jakubkrehel/oklch-skill) An agent skill that helps work with the OKLCH color space. You can convert colors, generate palettes, check contrast, gamut clamp, set up fallbacks and more. ## Install ```bash npx skills add jakubkrehel/oklch-skill ```
